claim: The 61st Venice Biennale Arte 2026 is officially titled 'In Minor Keys' and curated by Koyo Kouoh with her team.
quote: 61st International Art Exhibition In Minor Keys ... Curator Koyo Kouoh

claim: Biennale Arte 2026 runs from Saturday 9 May to Sunday 22 November 2026, with a pre-opening on 6-8 May.
quote: from Saturday, May 9th to Sunday, November 22nd, 2026

claim: Koyo Kouoh (1967-2025), the first African woman to curate the Venice Art Biennale, died in May 2025; her vision is carried forward by five professionals she selected: Gabe Beckhurst Feijoo, Marie Helene Pereira, Rasha Salti, Siddhartha Mitter, and Rory Tsapayi.
quote: Kouoh's vision carried forward by five professionals she personally selected: Gabe Beckhurst Feijoo, Marie Helene Pereira, Rasha Salti, Siddhartha Mitter, and Rory Tsapayi

claim: 'In Minor Keys' draws on musical structures of melancholy and intimacy, conceived as a polyphonous assembly with references to jazz improvisation and Caribbean poetics.
quote: In Minor Keys: Venice Biennale 2026 reveals its curatorial theme

claim: Manifesta 16 Ruhr, the European nomadic biennial, takes place 21 June to 4 October 2026 across Duisburg, Essen, Gelsenkirchen and Bochum in Germany's Ruhr region, themed around globalization.
quote: Manifesta to Hold Globalization-Themed Biennial in Germany's Ruhr Region in 2026

claim: 2026 marks Constable's 250th birthday (Tate Britain's 'Turner and Constable'), Brancusi's 150th (Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin survey of 150+ works), Modersohn-Becker's 150th (Dresden Albertinum), and Marilyn Monroe's centenary (National Portrait Gallery London, 4 June-6 Sept).
quote: Constantin Brancusi (150th birthday) - Major survey at Neue Nationalgalerie, Berlin (largest to date, over 150 works)

claim: Fondation Beyeler in Basel stages its first-ever monographic Cezanne retrospective, 25 January to 25 May 2026, with around 80 late-period paintings and watercolours.
quote: Cezanne ... Fondation Beyeler ... 25 January to 25 May 2026 ... around 80 oil paintings and watercolours

claim: Marking the 100th anniversary of Mary Cassatt's death, the Musee d'Orsay stages 'Mary Cassatt: The Choice of Independence' (6 Oct 2026-31 Jan 2027), the first major Cassatt show at a French national museum; 2026 is also the Orsay's own 40th anniversary.
quote: to mark the hundredth anniversary of the artist's death, the Musee d'Orsay is organizing a major exhibition devoted to Mary Cassatt (1844-1926)

claim: Artnet identifies twelve unmissable European museum shows for 2026, signalling a heavy blockbuster calendar across destination cities.
quote: 12 Unmissable Museum Shows to See Across Europe in 2026
